meta.title: Listen First (example)
meta.logline: Example storyboard for tests and mock runs: a boy in Dessie learns to repair radios. Not our film.

style.block: warm hand-painted gouache, soft golden-hour light, light film grain, muted ochre and teal palette

characters.description: a slim young man with short hair, a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a small screwdriver behind his ear

references.prompt: character sheet of the same young man: front view, three-quarter view and profile, plain background

shots.reason: Open on the town so the story has a place before it has a person.
shots.image_prompt: hills above Dessie at dawn, tin roofs catching the first light, mist in the valley

shots.reason: Introduce him through the habit that starts everything: listening.
shots.image_prompt: the young man as a boy, sitting on a wooden stool beside a small radio in a dim room, evening

motion.prompt: he leans slightly toward the radio, fixed camera

narration.en: He grew up in Dessie, listening to the radio every evening.
narration.am: ደሴ ውስጥ አደገ፤ በየምሽቱ ሬዲዮ ያዳምጥ ነበር።

shots.reason: The turn: the sound he loves stops.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of an old radio dial, its glow fading

narration.en: One day the radio went silent.

shots.reason: Curiosity instead of loss: he opens it.
shots.image_prompt: a boy's hands opening the back of an old radio on a table, a tangle of coloured wires inside

motion.prompt: the hands lift the back panel slowly, fixed camera

narration.en: He opened it, and found a world of wires.

shots.reason: Time passing: learning is slow and patient.
shots.image_prompt: the young man at night working under a small lamp, tools laid out neatly

narration.en: Night after night, he learned how each part works.
narration.am: ሌሊት ከሌሊት እያንዳንዱ ክፍል እንዴት እንደሚሠራ ተማረ።

shots.reason: The town comes to him: the skill gives him a place in the neighbourhood.
shots.image_prompt: a small repair stall on a busy street, neighbours waiting with radios in their hands

narration.en: Soon the whole neighbourhood brought him their radios.
narration.am: ብዙም ሳይቆይ የሰፈሩ ሰው ሁሉ ሬዲዮውን ያመጣለት ጀመር።

shots.reason: The saying the film is really about, in his words.
shots.image_prompt: the young man smiling, holding a radio to his ear, warm light on his face

motion.prompt: he turns his head slightly toward the radio and smiles, fixed camera

narration.en: He always says: listen first, then fix.
narration.am: ሁልጊዜ እንዲህ ይላል፦ መጀመሪያ አዳምጥ፣ ከዚያ አስተካክል።

shots.reason: Bring it back to the narrator: the story lives on in memory.
shots.image_prompt: an empty workbench at dusk with a single radio, a window open to the hills

narration.en: When I close my eyes, I can still hear his radios.
narration.am: ዓይኔን ስጨፍን አሁንም የእሱን ሬዲዮዎች እሰማለሁ።

cues.caption: gentle krar and soft strings, warm, nostalgic, sparse, no drums
cues.why: example: the quieter candidate leaves room for the voice
